name: Lundin Mining Corporation
content: Lundin Mining Corporation is a diversified Canadian base metals mining company with operations and projects in Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Portugal, Sweden, and the United States of America. The company primarily produces copper, zinc, gold, and nickel, which are essential for the global transition to a lower-carbon economy. Lundin Mining is committed to responsible mining practices and maintains a strong portfolio of high-quality assets, including the Candelaria and Caserones mines in Chile, the Neves-Corvo mine in Portugal, and the Eagle mine in the United States.

Officers

Jack Lundin(Date: 2023 December)

President and Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Lundin has over 15 years of experience in the natural resource sector. He was appointed President and CEO in December 2023. Previously, he served as President and CEO of Bluestone Resources Inc. and held various roles within the Lundin Group of companies, including at Lundin Gold Inc.'s Fruta del Norte project.

Teitur Poulsen(Date: 2023 September)

Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer

Mr. Poulsen has over 25 years of experience in the resource industry. He joined Lundin Mining as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer in 2023. Prior to this, he was CFO of Lundin Energy AB.

Juan Roca(Date: 2023 October)

Chief Operating Officer

Mr. Roca has over 25 years of experience in the mining industry. He was appointed Chief Operating Officer in 2023. He previously held senior operational roles at Freeport-McMoRan and other major mining firms.

Kristen Mariuzza(Date: 2023 January)

Senior Vice President, Sustainability, Health and Safety

Ms. Mariuzza has over 20 years of experience in the mining industry, specializing in environmental and regulatory affairs. She has held various leadership roles within Lundin Mining, including Managing Director of the Eagle Mine.

Directors

Adam Lundin(Date: 2022 May)

Chair of the Board

Mr. Lundin has many years of experience in the natural resource sector. He is the Chair of the Board and previously served as President and CEO of Josemaria Resources Inc.

Jack Lundin(Date: 2023 December)

Director

President and CEO of Lundin Mining. See executive profile for details.

Donald Charter(Date: 2015 May)

Independent Director

Mr. Charter is a professional director with extensive experience in the mining industry and capital markets. He has served on numerous public company boards.

Juliana Lam(Date: 2021 May)

Independent Director

Ms. Lam is a Chartered Professional Accountant with over 30 years of experience in financial management and corporate strategy across various industries.

Maria Olivia Recart(Date: 2023 May)

Independent Director

Ms. Recart is an economist with significant experience in the mining sector and public policy, having served as Vice President at BHP and Undersecretary of Finance in Chile.
